purpose: Classical fixed preprocessing strong reference only; no novel module and no reopening common
split: outer=min(sorted6 development units), never bundled or evaluated; validation=next sorted unit; train=remaining4
model: Unmodified frozen Model(mode='raw'), complete ResponseEncoder and SequenceHead; no surrogate or additional head
precision: FP32; autocast disabled; matmul TF32 and cuDNN TF32 off; deterministic algorithms on
target_transform: Unchanged frozen training-four cap125 mean/std target coordinates; identical across all four families
epoch_selection: none; exactly200 full passes; construct inner validation bundle only after final fit; one final prediction pass
pairing: Per subset/seed exact complete/encoder/head initial state hashes, CPU-generator epoch orders, block schedules, update count, scaler/processor identity must match across all four families
block_schedule: epoch_index modulo4; identical frozen forward with block present for aux0 and aux1; only total-loss coefficient changes

processor.fit_units: only current four training engines; raw/unit accessed; no labels used by processor
processor.physical_coordinates: Frozen bundle FP32 subtraction/division using FP32 raw_mu/raw_sd; then promote already-standardized training18 to FP64 for fitting
processor.W: First4 frozen-bundle FP32 channels are kept byte-identical in every arm
processor.scale: s=training-four fitted residual std(ddof0), floor1e-6; empirical descriptive residual scale, not noise
processor.apply: bundle.raw.double(); Xs_new=(Xs-Phi(W)@coef)/s in FP64 then cast FP32; retain W original FP32; all other bundle entries unchanged
processor.same_processor: Fit once per subset/train-four; identical full processor metadata/hash retained in all four families and all seeds, including raw families

auxiliary_interpretation: Frozen reconstruction target is current conditioned Xs and includes native basis penalty. Aux0 comparison isolates the supervised preprocessing package; aux1 also changes reconstruction coordinates. Do not call the factorial a pure loss-scale isolation
primary_metric: Inner-engine flight-end raw RUL RMSE; average three seeds within subset/family before ratios

gate.failure: No B1 continuation eligibility; preserve all cells and stop this screen without threshold, seed, subset, window or ridge changes
gate.success: Establish a classical preprocessing reference only; no novelty or common-route revival. Any learnable proposal requires separate mechanism review/registration and independent validation

failure_branch: OOM/nonfinite/budget errors preserve partial artifacts and FAILED; no missing-cell dropping, shortened-window substitution, early stopping, or incomplete positive gate
inference_limit: Only one chosen inner engine per subset; seed dispersion is training randomness, not independent-engine evidence; no significance claim
